title: ROMNet: a hybrid reduced order modeling and machine learning approach to waveform inversion
abstract: arXiv:2608.25160v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Waveform inversion seeks to estimate the wave speed of a heterogeneous, inaccessible medium, from time-resolved measurements of the waves at user controlled sensors. We consider this inverse problem for acoustic waves and an active array of source/receiver sensors that emit probing signals and measure the generated pressure waves. The forward map, from the wave speed to the measurements, is nonlinear and oscillatory. The oscillations cause cycle skipping, the main impediment to using the standard, nonlinear least-squares data fitting formulation, known as full waveform inversion (FWI). A recently introduced alternative waveform inversion approach computes from the measurements an algebraic surrogate of the wave operator, a reduced order model (ROM) matrix, which is then used to estimate the wave speed. The mapping from the measurements to the ROM is nonlinear, but well understood. It is computed efficiently, in a non-iterative manner.

translated_title: ROMNet：一种混合降阶建模与机器学习方法用于波形反演
translated_abstract: 波形反演旨在根据用户控制的传感器上随时间分辨的波测量数据，估计非均匀、不可访问介质的波速。我们考虑声波和主动源/接收传感器阵列的逆问题，这些传感器发射探测信号并测量产生的压力波。从波速到测量的正演映射是非线性和振荡的。这些振荡导致周期跳跃，这是标准非线性最小二乘数据拟合形式（即全波形反演，FWI）的主要障碍。最近引入的一种替代波形反演方法从测量数据计算波算子的代数替代品，即降阶模型（ROM）矩阵，然后用它来估计波速。从测量到ROM的映射是非线性的，但已被充分理解。它以一种非迭代方式高效计算。
tldr: 本文提出ROMNet，一种结合降阶建模与机器学习的新方法，通过非迭代地构建ROM矩阵来避免全波形反演中的周期跳跃问题，从而高效估计波速。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces ROMNet, a hybrid approach combining reduced order modeling and machine learning that avoids cycle skipping in full waveform inversion by non-iteratively constructing ROM matrices to efficiently estimate wave speed.
